verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party bulk export feature, no open-format (CSV/JSON) download, and nothing about off-boarding. The REST API, OpenAPI spec and MCP server are developer building blocks a user could use to build their own export. The BI/warehouse mention covers only reporting metrics and pipeline data, not all of a user's data, so it does not count as an export capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
